task: Refactor the existing `t_kan.py` neural network architecture to enforce strict causal constraints, eliminating architectural look-ahead bias.

user_stories.title: Architectural Causality Surgery (Monolithic Fix)
user_stories.description: Refactor src/models/t_kan.py to enforce strict architectural causality. Replace standard Conv1d layers with CausalConv1d (apply left padding `(kernel_size-1)*dilation` using F.pad, and set conv padding=0). Remove bidirectional=True from all RNNs/LSTMs. If there is Attention, apply a causal upper-triangular mask.
acceptance_criteria: All convolutions are strictly left-padded causal convolutions. No future data bleeds into the kernel.
Bidirectional flags are completely purged from the file.
The model mathematically cannot access time step t+1 when predicting for time step t.
user_stories.verification: python -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0, '.'); import torch; from src.models.t_kan import create_model; m = create_model(); m.eval(); x = torch.randn(2, 1000, 40); y1 = m(x); x_mod = x.clone(); x_mod[:, 500:, :] = 100.0; y2 = m(x_mod); max_diff = torch.max(torch.abs(y1[:, :499, :] - y2[:, :499, :])).item(); assert max_diff < 1e-4, f'CAUSALITY LEAK: Future data changed past predictions! Max diff: {max_diff}'"
user_stories.why: To mathematically guarantee no look-ahead bias exists in the neural network graph, preventing Reward Hacking.
